info.name: NPR Identity Service Authorization Stationfinder API
NPR List stations close to you or filter by search criteria

params.name: q
params.description: Search terms to search on; can be a station name, network name, call letters, or zipcode

params.name: city
params.description: A city to look for stations from; intended to be paired with `state`

params.name: state
params.description: A state to look for stations from (using the 2-letter abbreviation); intended to be paired with `city`

params.name: lat
params.description: A latitude value from a geographic coordinate system; only works if paired with `lon`

params.name: lon
params.description: A longitude value from a geographic coordinate system; only works if paired with `lat`

items.docs:
This endpoint has two main use cases:

- If no query parameters passed in, it returns a list of stations that are geographically closest to the calling client (based on GeoIP information)
- If one or more query parameters are passed in, it performs a search of NPR stations that match those search criteria (not taking into account the client's physical location)

info.name: NPR Retrieve metadata for the station with the given numeric ID

params.name: stationId
params.description: The numeric ID of a station

items.docs:
This endpoint retrieves information about a given station, based on its numeric ID, which is consistent across all of NPR's APIs.

A typical use case for this data is for clients who want to create a dropdown menu, modal/pop-up or dedicated page displaying more information about the station the client is localized to, including, for example, links to the station's homepage and donation (pledge) page.
